Microsoft [PROCESS_HEAP_ENTRY](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/minwinbase/ns-minwinbase-process_heap_entry) explicitly distinguishes `cbData` from allocator `cbOverhead`; Microsoft [PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/psapi/ns-psapi-process_memory_counters_ex) defines `PrivateUsage` as commit charge. The metrics are **not interchangeable**.
